text_block_list.text: After a day out...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna head back now.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
What? There something you wanted to
do?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
That's not it, but I'm taken aback by her
coldness
toward me despite having
spent the whole day
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Did you not have a good time today?

text_block_list.text: What do you mean? It was fine.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: I wanted you to have fun...

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, ease off already. That's for me to
decide.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Whether or not I have fun is none of
your
business.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: We done? I wanna go home already.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
A new weapon comes out today. I gotta
check it out
ASAP.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
It's true that I can't force her to have
fun, but I
really want her to feel glad
that she came out
today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Then I'll just bring the fun to you!

text_block_list.text:
Huh? I have absolutely no idea what
you're
talking about.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: I want to see you smile.

text_block_list.text: ...Tch.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: You're an idiot.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I expect her to leave after insulting me,
but she
doesn't. It seems like she's
waiting for my next
move.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Since she likes gaming, maybe I should
suggest
some kind of game we can play.
That would surely
keep her entertained!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What am I, a child? No way.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Why did I even stay? I should've just
left...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Well, that was a total flop. She looks
beyond
unimpressed, but I can't let this
chance slip away!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Are you seriously playing by yourself?
Do you
have any shame at all?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Siiigh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I struggle to keep the game going by
myself while
she pointedly ignores me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Seriously, will you knock it off already?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Welcome! We've got some freshly baked
pastries
and desserts of all kinds! Come
and take a
look! ♪
text_block_list.name: Baker

text_block_list.text: Oh, they even have custard...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Ack! N-no, I didn't mean to say that!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I wasn't playing your stupid game! I was
just
looking at the custard pastry!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
Ohhh! I said "mustard" and you followed up with
"custard"!

text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you telling me you didn't even
notice?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Arrgh! Me and my big mouth!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Seriously?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: You really think you're a match for me?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: I might be able to catch you if I try really hard?

text_block_list.text:
Why would you suggest a battle you
can't win?
You could've said literally any
other game.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: I wanted to play something you would enjoy.

text_block_list.text:
You make it sound like I'm some
hyperactive
kid...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Whatever. You asked for it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Well, see ya.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Whoa! I have to catch up!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately for me, Umamusume are
fast even
when they're not trying. No
matter how hard I run,
there's no way I
can catch her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Still no sign of my dumb trainer.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Psh... There's no way a regular person
could stand
a chance against me. How'd
I get stuck with the
world's stupidest
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
And what was that whole thing about
wanting to
see me smile? What a weirdo.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I probably should have waited instead of

sprinting off so fast...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
What am I even saying? This is
ridiculous.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I don't, and I wasn't playing with you! Ugh, wipe that dumb smile off your face!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
